title: A ring ceremony - you're invited.
description: A lot of our members and followers are watching and enjoying the Verreaux's Eagle Owlet (Bubo lacteus) on the EcoSolutions Owl Cam. It is all really exciting at the moment as the owlet is often alone on the nest and is growing rapidly. On Monday, 21st September, we are placing a ring on the Verreaux's Eagle Owlet. Join us on Facebook live.
html:
We are going to be ringing the owlet on Monday, 21st September 2020 between 17h00 and 18h00. It will be a wonderful event and we would love to have you attend virtually. The event will be held through Facebook Live where we will be able to answer any of your questions. The link to the Facebook Live event can be found here. I hope that you will join us.

Please feel free to share this with friends and family that may be interested in attending.

If you cannot attend the live ringing event, please feel free to sign up to our Facebook page or YouTube channel where you can watch the recorded footage at your convenience.
